warnings: Gas-fuelled stern block: the genset envelopes beyond the published engine (alternator, base frame) and the engine-room and GVU-room clearances are ESTIMATES (no vendor GA). The exhaust uptake and the fuel vent mast are not in the air draft (assumed lowerable). Fuel is taken from the cargo boil-off (IGC Code chapter 16); no separate fuel tank is in the block.
Separation clauses are cited from the classification rules for inland-waterways ships (Pt 4 Ch 4 Sec 3, Jul 2022). Confirm against the ADN text before release.

The lightship uses 4872.0 t of hull steel (top-down); the cost prices 2284.7 t (bottom-up). They differ by 2587.3 t (113.2 %), more than the 20 % limit (an Estimate). The cost keeps the bottom-up mass.

limitations: Concept-stage: the hull's sections, first-order weight heights, no downflooding openings.
No wind heel and no damage stability. Both are needed before approval: damage stability by ADN 9.3.1.15 and IGC 2.7, wind heel by the IS Code 2008 weather criterion (Part A 2.3).
Ballast and consumables tanks are moulded volumes with no structure deduction; one tank per side and kind, and the consumables tank height is an estimate.

fuel_gas.basis: Wartsila 20DF Product Guide 1/2018 p. 3-1 (6L20DF, gas mode, 160 kW per cylinder), a published dual-fuel genset of the same size class: a stand-in Estimate until a maker's sheet for the chosen genset is found

boil_off.basis: Conduction through the insulation at the upper ambient design air temperature (IGC Code 7.2), over the latent heat of methane (NIST saturation table); domes, saddles and pipes are not in the heat leak. The conductivity is an Estimate.

cost.basis: Example rates — replace with yours. Current estimates.

tank_internals.basis: An assumption, not a sourced value: no source read gives how much of the tank structure surplus is stiffeners and ring frames. That share is priced at the tank shell rate; the rest (saddles) at the supports rate.

calibration.basis: No calibration case covers the lightship of a gas barge: the build-up uses fixed factors.

The lightship uses 6475.7 t of hull steel (top-down); the cost prices 2447.2 t (bottom-up). They differ by 4028.5 t (164.6 %), more than the 20 % limit (an Estimate). The cost keeps the bottom-up mass.

limitations: Concept-stage: the hull's sections, first-order weight heights, no downflooding openings.
No wind heel and no damage stability. Both are needed before approval: damage stability by ADN 9.3.1.15 and IGC 2.7, wind heel by the IS Code 2008 weather criterion (Part A 2.3).
